host_data_unavailable: Data directory needs a compatible Levix version or repair from a backup.
guide_start_body: This circle starts Levix. Allow notifications when asked so the assistant can keep running while the screen is off.
guide_battery_body: When this card shows a restriction, tap Enable Battery Guard and choose Unrestricted. Without it, Android may stop Levix while the screen is locked.
guide_panel_body: This button connects WhatsApp and later opens the panel. Choose a password on first use; commands, the AI and group settings all live there.
guide_link_body: This card shows whether WhatsApp is linked. Tap it for the full status; to link your phone, open the panel, go to Connection and request a pairing code.
guide_media_body: Media Hub browses the WhatsApp statuses, photos, videos and voice notes stored on this phone. Nothing leaves the phone, and you choose what to save.
guide_privacy_body: Levix runs on this phone and talks only to WhatsApp and the services you enable. Logs and crash reports wait here until you save, share or delete them.
guide_header_body: These two icons switch between Arabic and English, and between light and dark. Levix remembers your choice.
guide_again_sub: Replay this tour of the home screen
crash_prompt_body: A crash report is saved on this phone. You can review it before choosing whether to send it.
host_shell_note: Autonomous background companion. Open Panel to manage settings.
hero_title:
Your WhatsApp assistant,
always by your side.
hero_subtitle_running: Levix is running in the background. Tap the circle to open the control panel.
hero_subtitle_stopped: Levix is stopped. Tap the circle to start your assistant.
section_overview_sub: Core system health at a glance
card_whatsapp_desc_connected: Connected and active. Ready to receive and answer messages.
card_whatsapp_desc_pairing: Waiting for device link. Tap Open Control Panel to link via phone code.
card_whatsapp_desc_paused: Network connection paused. Will reconnect automatically once internet returns.
card_engine_desc_running: Engine is running normally in the background.
card_engine_desc_stopped: Engine is inactive. All settings and data are preserved.
battery_ok: Battery optimizations are disabled. Android and device restrictions may still affect background operation.
battery_hint: Android may restrict background operation. Allow unrestricted battery to reduce interruptions.
logs_actions_body: The host log stays on this phone until you save or send it.
logs_action_save_open_sub: Copy to Downloads/Levix and open it with a viewer
logs_action_share_sub: Send the log file to another app
logs_open_missing: Saved to Downloads/Levix. No app on this phone can open a .log file.
notifications_required: Notification permission is required so the assistant can stay alive.
notif_alerts_channel_description: Alerts when the connection is lost
notif_offline_network: No internet connection. WhatsApp bot is paused.
diagnostics_panel_hint: Tap to save, open or share the log file.
card_whatsapp_desc_failed_long: Reconnection failed after several attempts. Your settings and data are safe; start the assistant again or reconnect from the control panel.
card_whatsapp_desc_expired_long: This device is no longer linked to WhatsApp. Pair it again from the control panel to resume.
card_whatsapp_desc_connecting_long: Connecting to WhatsApp. The status will update automatically.
card_whatsapp_desc_offline_long: The assistant is not running, so there is no WhatsApp connection. Start the assistant to connect.
media_hub_subtitle: Browse statuses and WhatsApp media on this phone
media_rationale: Levix needs media access to discover and display WhatsApp photos, videos and audio stored on your device. Your files stay on your device and are not uploaded.
media_partial: Only selected photos and videos are visible. Select more or allow all in Settings.
media_audio_permission: Allow audio access to see WhatsApp voice notes and audio.
media_enable_status_info: Statuses or documents may need access to the WhatsApp Media folder.
media_wrong_folder: Choose a WhatsApp Media or .Statuses folder.
media_not_installed: WhatsApp is not installed, or no media is available.
media_empty: No media found here. Pull down to refresh.
media_sticker_too_large: Too large for a sticker — pick something under 16 MB.
media_sticker_size_unknown: Android did not report this file's size, so it can't be turned into a sticker.
media_sticker_unsupported: Only images, GIFs and videos can become stickers.
media_share_failed: Nothing on this device can open that file.
media_unavailable: This file is no longer available.
media_unsupported: No app can open this format.
media_delete_saved_only: Only Levix-saved copies can be deleted.
media_delete_failed: Some saved copies could not be deleted.
home_stopped_body: Start the engine on this phone. Then connect WhatsApp securely in the control panel.
home_starting_body: Preparing the local engine and control panel. This may take a moment.
home_engine_error_body: The engine could not stay running. Review diagnostics. You can stop the assistant, then start it again.
home_start_timeout: Startup is taking longer than expected. Review diagnostics before trying again.
home_pairing_body: Next, open Connection in the control panel. Start the WhatsApp session and choose a pairing code for this phone, or scan a QR from another screen.
home_ready_body: The engine is ready and WhatsApp is connected. Manage commands, AI and groups in the control panel.
home_reconnecting_body: The engine is ready. WhatsApp is reconnecting automatically. No engine restart is needed.
home_paused_body: The engine is ready, but the network is unavailable. WhatsApp will reconnect automatically when internet access returns.
home_expired_body: WhatsApp logged out. Open Connection to link your account again. The engine is still ready.
home_connection_error_body: The engine is ready, but WhatsApp is offline. Open Connection to review the issue and resume the session.
home_unknown_body: The engine is ready, but WhatsApp status is not confirmed. Open Connection to check it.
home_linking_body: The engine is ready. Waiting for WhatsApp to confirm the connection.
home_step_connect: Step 2 of 3 · Connect WhatsApp · Engine ready
home_start_rejected: Android could not start the service. Try again with the app open, or review diagnostics.
